stage1.impression: A symmetrical, stage-set view of two salmon-pink boxes in green-lit recesses, framed by out-of-focus mint chair backs and a pinkish ball on a hexagonal table, all floating in a black void with no ceiling or side walls. The speakers glow like flat neon signs rather than tinted cast acrylic, the end-grain wall reads as a plank texture with a grid drawn over it, and the carpet reads as grey-brown haze, not bottle green. It reads as a game or architectural-viz render, not a photograph. A magazine would not run it as a specific place: it reads as a generic hi-fi showroom vignette.

blocking_9: The Ember speakers read as tinted acrylic with internal depth and polished glowing edges, not flat emissive pink: no clipping on the cabinets (clip_pct < 1 in each speaker region) and visible batts, horn and edge highlights
The niche lining reads as real oak end-grain blocks (growth rings, per-block variation, no grain running continuously across the block joints)
The zone reads bottle green at a glance: carpet and walls measurably green, not grey-brown
The room exists around the niche: ceiling, beams and side walls hold detail (no flat black void over a quarter of the frame)
The Sphere lamp reads as smoked acrylic with a frosted liner glowing inside, not a matte pink ball, and the table top is not the brightest object in the frame
Signs of life in the zone (a glass, a record, a coat) and a believable seated, slightly off-axis viewpoint instead of a dead-centre stage view
Full-resolution render without denoiser smear on the chairs and wall

defects.what: Left Ember cabinet reads as flat pink neon: clip_pct 4.0, p95 196, no acrylic depth or edge highlights
Right Ember cabinet the same: clip_pct 4.3, flat emissive look
Resin horn top reads as a dull red plastic box with smeared reflections
End-grain block wall reads as a long-grain plank texture with a superimposed grid; grain runs continuously across block joints (tiling, wrong material scale)
Green felt panel shows a hard, clean CG spotlight cone; elsewhere the felt is a flat, textureless slab
Black void above the niche frame (lum_median 14, range 3): no ceiling, beams or room
Black void at the left (lum_median 17, range 5): the room's walls are missing
Carpet reads grey-brown concrete in haze (r 56, g 45, b 37), not bottle-green wool
Sphere lamp reads as a matte pink ball; table top over-lit (lum_median 114) and the brightest surface in the lower frame
Foreground chairs are bright, minty and featureless (lum_median 62, brighter than the speakers), with denoiser smear and no velvet pile
Dead-centre symmetric composition and no props in the zone: no sign of life

changes.problem: The Ember cabinets clip and read as flat neon rather than tinted cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 4.02, lum_p95 196, lum_median 50; right speaker clip_pct 4.26

change.setting: on each Ember speaker 4 x area (W/m2 at the target)
change.to: 6.0 W/m2, 2900 K, and place the areas as raking side/top lights so the polished edges catch a line of light instead of the faces being flooded

changes.expected: Cabinets hold tint and internal detail (batts, horn, edges), no clipping, speaker median stays around 45 to 55 with the exposure change in c4.

changes.problem: The end-grain niche lining is a long-grain plank texture with a grid on top, so it reads as tiled CG wallpaper.

evidence.measured: crop at 3x: horizontal grain runs unbroken across block joints; lum_range only 17 across the wall

change.setting: end-grain block material (texture mapping; the material stays oak end grain)
change.from: one long-grain texture with a grid overlay
change.to: per-block end-grain texture with growth rings and checks, random rotation and offset per block, ±10% tone variation per block, joints as real 1-2 mm recessed gaps with bump

changes.expected: Each block reads as its own slice of oak; the wall gains real texture under the altar spots.

changes.problem: The bottle-green carpet reads as grey-brown, so the one saturated zone does not register.

evidence.measured: r_median 56, g_median 45, b_median 37: red-dominant, near neutral

change.setting: the floor's polish / carpet finish (check the zone's carpet material is assigned)
change.from: polished, sheen-lit floor reading as grey concrete
change.to: deep bottle-green wool carpet, roughness 1.0, sheen 0.3, with a fibre bump; no specular polish

changes.expected: The floor of the zone reads green under the warm light, tying the chairs, felt and carpet into one zone.

changes.problem: Over a quarter of the frame is a flat black void, so the niche floats like a stage set with no room around it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 14.4, lum_range 3.2; left edge [0,30,60,330] lum_median 16.9, range 5

change.setting: the Domes' downlights and render exposure
change.to: Domes 320 W with cone 60 deg so some spill reaches the beams and side walls; exposure 0.35

changes.expected: Ceiling beams and side walls hold dim detail; the frame stays a night room.

changes.problem: The Sphere lamp reads as a matte pink ball and over-lights the table, making it the brightest thing in the lower frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 114, p95 198; sphere has no visible smoked shell or inner liner

change.setting: each Sphere W and its liner's glow; frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: 3.0 W, glow 0.3, outer smoked shell glossy (roughness 0.05) so the frosted liner reads as a glow inside a dark sphere

changes.expected: A small warm pool on the table, the lamp reads as a dark smoked sphere with a glowing core, table no brighter than the speakers' highlights.

changes.problem: Dead-centre, standing-height symmetry with large blurry chair backs filling the bottom third reads as a viz stage, not a photographer's seated view.

evidence.measured: chairs lum_median 62, brighter than the speakers' median (45 to 50); vertical profile rises to 72 in the bottom bin

change.to: position [12.4, 3.6, 1.1] (from the best seat, slightly off axis), lens 40 mm, f/2.8 focused on the right Ember, aim level so verticals stay true

changes.expected: One speaker large and sharp in the frame, the other receding, a single chair arm and the table in soft foreground, not a wall of mint shapes.

changes.problem: No sign of life in the zone.

evidence.measured: table holds only the lamp; chairs empty and bare

change.to: on the hex table a rocks glass with ice-melt and a record sleeve leaning against the lamp; a coat or scarf over one chair arm; a record out of its sleeve on the altar plinth

changes.expected: The zone reads as used tonight, not staged.

changes.problem: The altar spots draw a hard, clean CG cone on flat felt.

evidence.measured: green panel lum_median 36, range 12.5; visible sharp cone tip at top

change.to: 40.0 W, 2500 K, cone 50 deg with blend 0.6, and a felt bump/fuzz on the panels

changes.expected: A soft wash on the felt and the tops of the speakers with no geometric cone tip.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Ember cabinets a deeper, less salmon red
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour is fixed; only their lighting (c1) may change.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the minty tub chairs with a darker, more saturated velvet or a different chair
out_of_scope.why: The seats and zone colour are fixed; a finish change toward deeper bottle green with velvet pile may be checked against the zone colour instead.

out_of_scope.request: Swap the matte sphere for a different lamp design
out_of_scope.why: The Sphere lamp is an EARF product placeholder; only its light levels and the frosted acrylic roughness may change (c5).
